第(1/3)页

“苏总！”

“怎么了？”

苏行舟的状态自然，他不是李雪，无所谓被人看到这么暧昧的一幕。

他是苏总。

平台老总＋制片人，他就没想遮遮掩掩。

其实李雪也不在乎，她按摩的手还是没停....

害羞归害羞，她还是想好好给苏行舟按按，帮他释放压力。

反正她确实是“走后门”进的剧组。

“苏总，刚才接到电话，齐卫东女儿的演员在家里出事了。”王伟装作没看见李雪的动作：

“她在家里洗澡的时候，在浴室滑倒了，脑震荡起码要休息一个多月。”

“这么巧？”

苏行舟眉头一挑，倒是没多大反应。

这个角色就四集戏份，镜头不多。

对演员要求也不高，演员出事了换一个就是了。

“你有推荐的人选吗？重新找一个合适的吧。”

王伟和五百也混了这么多年，演员资源肯定不缺，随便找个人顶上就行。

可是王伟意外的有些语塞。

他以为苏行舟要自己找演员，脑袋里一时间还真没想到合适的人选。

苏行舟在剧组独揽大权的日子，王伟都有些习惯了。

在苏行舟手底下当工具人导演还挺惬意的。

“15岁的女孩子吗？”李雪突然开口道：“对演技没有要求？颜值气质好就行吗？”

“雪姐有推荐？”

李雪犹豫了一下，觉得自己插手苏行舟工作不太合适。

但是想起那个学妹的眼睛，又心软了。

苏行舟看出她的顾虑，笑了：

“尽管推荐就是了，用不用还是我决定，推荐面试很正常的。”

“我有一个学妹，最近家里出了点事情，想要勤工俭学。”

.........

“李雪，有人找你。”

场务提醒刚拍完戏的李雪。

Page (1/3)

"Mr. Su!"

"What's wrong?"

Su Xingzhou was in a natural state. He was not Li Xue, so he didn't mind being seen in such an ambiguous scene.

He is Mr. Su.

Platform CEO + Producer, he doesn’t want to be secretive.

In fact, Li Xue didn't care, her massaging hands didn't stop...

Even though she was shy, she still wanted to give Su Xingzhou a good massage to help him relieve his stress.

Anyway, she did enter the crew through the "back door".

"Mr. Su, I just received a call that the actress of Qi Weidong's daughter had an accident at home." Wang Wei pretended not to see Li Xue's movements:

"She slipped in the bathroom while taking a shower at home. She suffered a concussion and will have to rest for at least more than a month."

"What a coincidence?"

Su Xingzhou raised his eyebrows, but didn't react much.

This character only plays in four episodes and doesn't have many scenes.

The requirements for actors are not very high. If something happens to an actor, just replace him.

"Do you have any recommendations? Let's find a suitable one."

Wang Wei and Wu Bai have been around for so many years, so there is definitely no shortage of actor resources, so just find someone to take over.

But Wang Wei was unexpectedly speechless.

He thought Su Xingzhou wanted to find an actor himself, but he really didn't think of a suitable candidate for a while.

Wang Wei was somewhat used to the days when Su Xingzhou had all the power in the crew.

It's quite satisfying to be a tool director under Su Xingzhou.

"A 15-year-old girl?" Li Xue suddenly said: "There is no requirement for acting skills? Is it okay if you have good looks and temperament?"

"Sister Xue, do you have any recommendations?"

Li Xue hesitated for a moment, feeling that it was not appropriate for him to intervene in Su Xingzhou's work.

But thinking about that school girl's eyes, I softened my heart again.

Su Xingzhou saw her concerns and smiled:

"Although a recommendation is enough, it's up to me to decide whether to use it or not. Recommendation interviews are normal."

"I have a schoolgirl who wants to work-study because something happened at home recently."

.........

"Li Xue, someone is looking for you."

The scene manager reminded Li Xue who had just finished filming.
